content: Human-labeling session — combat-tank-vs-tank-engagement:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a combat engagement on a 128x40 arena with a tight clock and seed-varied staging. You are given a Construction Yard at (4,20) and 3 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) bunched at x=30, in either the NORTH corridor (y=11-13) or the SOUTH corridor (y=27-29) depending on seed — read your own position from the map. The enemy holds a fixed vertical line of 3 medium tanks at (50, 15), (51, 20), and (50, 25) on Defend orders. Score 3 kills, keep at least 2 tanks alive, hold the Construction Yard, within 1500 ticks.
